Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

4. Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 The surface shall be free from pits, cracks, scales, all greases, grinding agents and polishing 
compounds. 

4.2 The edges of the tri-fin at the tip shall be sharp. 

4.3 The nails shall be of one piece without riveting or welding. 

4.4 The nail shall be ultrasonically cleaned, electropolished and then passivated. 

4.5 The screws if provided shall conform to IS : 5393-1969 ' Specification for screws, bone '. 

5. Tests 

5.1 Corrosion Resistance Test-Test the nails in accordance with IS : 7531-1975 * Method for boiling 
and autoclaving test for corrosion resistance of stainless steel surgical instruments '- The nails 
shall show no sign of corrosion after the test. 

5.2 Radiological Test— Shall be according to 6.2 of IS: 5347-1969. 

6. Marking — Shall be according to 5.1 of IS : 5347-1969. 

6.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

7. Packing -As agreed between the purchaser and the manufacturer.
